note: Practical priors about bowfishing are hypotheses until validated on field data; fit-for-purpose targets are pre-declared requirements, not achievements.
role: Underwater visibility (how far a bowfisher can see the fish)
bowfishingPurpose: Bowfishing is sight shooting: clarity sets how deep a fish can be seen with a light at night, and rain, runoff and wind-driven mixing can cut visibility within a day.
decisionsInformed: is the water clear enough to see fish at shooting depth
which arm of the lake is clearer after rain
mustNotPredict: clarity from a satellite scene older than 14 days

needsFrom.why: wind resuspends sediment and chops the surface

fitForPurpose.rationale: a 1 ft error changes whether a 3 ft shot is visible

priorityQuestions: How fast does clarity decay after rain at reservoirs of different type?
Do new Secchi observations confirm the R3.1 candidate?
abstainWhen: no scene or gauge within limits
